t: The Sylvania RefLed Superia GU10 LED light bulb offers a high-performance, energy-efficient lighting solution, designed to seamlessly replace traditional halogen lamps. This professional-grade 6W bulb provides 575 lumens of bright, warm light, making it ideal for retail displays, hospitality venues, and contemporary residential projects. Featuring a long lifespan of up to 25,000 hours and dimmable capability, it ensures consistent illumination and reduced replacement frequency. Recreates backlight effect similar to halogen dichroic lamps.
